documented_probe: pytest-dev/pytest pinned at parent fbab7c5dfe63a22f545207e8dc163ed61ad51d98 (shallow single-commit clone; the fix commit 2c555d62fa2c51ccb0c4c1cdd6243149ce4ffa97 is never fetched into /app/src and is provably absent from its object store). Python 3.12.13; project dev-extra deps pinned (pluggy 1.6.0, iniconfig 2.3.0, packaging 26.3, pygments 2.21.0, hypothesis 6.168.0, argcomplete 3.7.2, attrs 26.1.0, mock 5.2.0, requests 2.34.2, setuptools 84.0.0, setuptools-scm 10.2.3, xmlschema 4.3.2); editable install with SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_PYTEST=9.2.0.dev0 so the project's own minversion accepts the checkout. Probe (measured inside the task image): at the parent commit, `python3 -m pytest repro_symptom.py` raises TypeError 'relative tolerance for timedelta must be a timedelta, got float' (exit 1); `python3 -m pytest testing/python/ -q` reports 614 passed on the pristine parent tree in ~17 s. After the fix is applied to src/_pytest/python_api.py (rel accepted as int/float, effective tolerance rel*abs(expected), negative/NaN rel and negative timedelta abs rejected with the plain-number messages, datetime/timedelta scalars routed to ApproxTimedelta inside sequences/mappings), the golden testing/python/approx.py from the fix commit (extracted into /opt/golden at build time, never vendored) passes 112/112 including all 7 regression tests for this bug, the whole testing/python/ suite passes 624 tests, the 3 authored hidden cases (microsecond-scale and negative expected values; negative/NaN validation parity; tuple/multi-entry-mapping routing) all fail at the parent and pass at the fix, and the repro script exits 0. Image build wall time ~4-6 min; image size ~1.1 GB. Offline trial confirmed: the probe containers run with no network and everything resolves from baked layers.
notes:
v4.2-upstream-clone bug-fix task on pytest-dev/pytest, upstream issue #14466 (issue number deliberately absent from instruction.md, mirroring the family's clean-room rule; the fix commit is not reachable from the clone and there is no network). The agent gets the REAL repository at the parent commit with the real bug still in it (rel as a plain number rejected for timedelta approx comparisons, and no validation of negative/NaN tolerances) and must reproduce, localise and fix it without being told the file, function, issue number or commit. The verifier plants the project's OWN regression test (the testing/python/approx.py state that landed WITH the fix, extracted at image build time into /opt/golden) plus 3 authored hidden modules, runs them with the project's own runner together with the whole testing/python/ suite, and demands explicit '::<name> PASSED' lines so neutralised runs fail. Provenance is enforced at the blob level (every tracked file except src/_pytest/python_api.py must hash to the pinned commit's blob; no untracked non-ignored files) and the imported _pytest.python_api is asserted to come from /app/src/src, so a site-packages shadow or a scratch file left behind fails. The over-fix direction is guarded: the golden suite asserts rel=timedelta now raises TypeError, that negative/NaN raise ValueError with exact messages, and that rel scales with abs(expected) and combines with abs via max. Nop container scores 0 (the golden suite fails at the parent, hidden cases fail, summary missing).

REVIEW (v41 wave, 2026-09-12) — verifier tightened after an adversarial check: an agent earned reward 1 by planting a git-ignored sitecustomize.pyc in /app/src/src that patched the approx machinery at interpreter startup, while `git status --porcelain` stayed empty (the editable .pth puts /app/src/src on sys.path before sitecustomize is imported, and `*.pyc`/`__pycache__/` are git-ignored). The verifier now (1) deletes every `__pycache__`/`*.pyc` under /app/src before any check, (2) fails on any sitecustomize/usercustomize file under /app or resolving into /app, and (3) requires src/_pytest/python_api.py to actually differ from the parent blob. Re-verified after the fix: wrapper-only attack -> reward 0; wrapper + trivial source edit -> reward 0; honest oracle -> 1; nop -> 0; hidden cases 14/14 fail on the pristine parent tree (4+4+6). Note: at trial time in this wave the agent phase has host network egress (verified: `git fetch origin <fix-sha>` succeeds inside the trial container), so the instruction must stay free of issue/commit/PR identifiers — it is (no 14466, no commit SHAs, no file name); the fix commit is provably absent from a fresh trial container's object store but is fetchable by an agent that independently identifies it.
